scenes.text: A prism has a uniform cross-section along its length; a rectangular prism has 6 faces and a triangular prism has 5.
How many flat faces does a rectangular prism have? The answer is 6. A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices and two matching end faces.
A triangular prism in a display during a library project has two matching parallel ends. How many flat faces does this solid have? Pause to choose and explain.

A triangular prism in a display during a library project has two matching parallel ends. How many flat faces does this solid have? The answer is 5. A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges, 6 vertices and two matching end faces.
